subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
6. 
Total Assets & Current Liabilities of Suyash Limited are ` 45 lakhs & ` 5 lakhs 
respectively. ROCE is 20%, measure of business operating risk (operating leverage) is 
3, and P/V ratio is 80%. Calculate Sales. 
(a)  
18 lakhs 
(b)  
30 lakhs 
(c)  
24 lakhs 
(d)  
32 lakhs 
(2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (B) ROCE = EBIT / Total Capital Employed Total Capital Employed = Total Assets – Current Liabilities = 45 lakhs – 5 lakhs = 40 lakhs EBIT = 40 lakhs × 20% = 8 lakhs Operating Leverage (3) = Contribution / EBIT Therefore, Contribution = 8 lakhs × 3 = 24 lakhs Sales = Contribution / P/V Ratio = 24 lakhs / 0.80 = 30 lakhs
